entities.name: Shingol
entities.description: A fishing village on the west coast of Terisiare during the Dark Age of Dominaria, impoverished when the leer fish migrated south.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent on whose west coast Shingol lay.

entities.name: Eln Forest
entities.description: Forest north of Iwset toward which Shingol lay.

entities.name: Urhaalan Valley
entities.description: Valley a week's travel from Shingol.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane of the Dark Age setting.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Native of Shingol, foster brother of Essa.

entities.name: Sigil of Iwset
entities.description: Found under the floorboards of Yunnie's old room in Shingol.

events.summary: The cooling climate drives the leer fish south, leaving Shingol destitute; villagers turn to deep-sea netting.
events.quote: the cooling climate during the period eventually drove the leer fish to migrate south, leaving Shingol destitute.

relations.quote: Yunnie and his foster siter Essa were from Shingol
